content.short: Boost is an onchain rewards network to incentivize any onchain action.
content.description: Boost is an onchain rewards network that enables you to incentivize any onchain action with tokens. When boosts are deployed, participants are encouraged to help distribute and validate them across multiple integrated clients reaching millions of wallets. With Boost you can deploy onchain incentive campaigns using an SDK or no-code tools in minutes, use Budget Accounts to restrict token incentives to contracts, and access a broader network of incentivized clients to help drive transactions on your network.
